domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report supply split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 / JS challenge; DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection refused, so no domestic-supply record was located. Mother Dairy's domestic retail supply is widely known but no verifiable record was captured in this session — treated as not confirmed.
note: Real export shipments ARE documented: 5 dated US-customs import rows (2018–2022), destination Yokohama/Japan, buyer DKSH Japan K.K., B/L numbers BLR300H1CC00, BLR900141100, BLR200287200, BLR900291400, BLR800241100. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: all confirmed shipments are HS 210011 (mango pulp, i.e. 2007/2106-type processed fruit), NOT the declared fresh-vegetable codes 070190/070490/070960/070999. No shipment row with any 07xx code was seen for this entity; the Port Blair and 'Mother Dairy Fruit and Vegetable Private Limited' ImportKey pages rendered as empty paywall shells (0 rows visible). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in base, actual HS should be corrected to the observed processed-fruit/pulp code, verdict accepted_hs_corrected.
